description: React component for the pinned section of a side menu in the Notesnook app, managing pinned notebooks and tags with drag-and-drop reordering.

classes.name: PinnedSection
classes.description: React memoized component rendering a list of pinned notebooks and tags with drag-and-drop reordering.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles press events on menu items, navigating to notebooks or tags and closing the drawer.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long press events, presenting properties for dragging if not already dragging.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders individual menu items using the MenuItem component.
